answer: Locks are entered in ledge, expire in spiral, and vine lists each expiry. Someone running 185 aliases hence needs 22 simultaneously locked bonds rather than one rotating pool. The admission bond is time locked for 14 epochs, longer than any single challenge window, so capital cannot be cycled between aliases within one epoch. A farm of 1453 identities would post 3907 proofs and burn roughly 54 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
